tools.name: search_models
tools.description:
Search active speech models. Filters combine (AND). Paged: pass next_offset to get more.

    language: BCP-47 code, e.g. "hi" or "en-GB". Only models that explicitly list it are returned, unless
    include_unlisted_languages=true also adds models that claim "many languages" without listing them. c

tools.name: get_model
tools.description:
One model's record: pricing with all variants (e.g. streaming vs pre-recorded) and source, languages,
    capabilities with notes (e.g. "pre-recorded only, English only"), regions, interfaces, audio formats,
    limits, lifecycle, shutdown date and replacement, open-weights licence, provenance. mode

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description:
Compare up to 6 models side by side. Each item can be an exact key "provider/type/model_id" (from
    search_models) or a loose name like "deepgram nova-3" or "Cartesia Sonic 3". A loose name resolves to the
    best match and says so in matched_as (with other_candidates): tell the user what was ass

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description:
Cost in USD for a workload, computed here so no unit conversion is left to the model.

    models: keys or loose names (up to 6). characters: text to synthesize (TTS). audio_minutes: audio to
    transcribe (STT/STS), or for TTS the minutes of speech to produce (converted with tts_chars_per_minute,

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description:
Replacements for a model (e.g. one that is shutting down): active models of the same type, ranked by how
    many of its explicitly listed languages they cover, then shared features, then how close the price is. The
    provider's own announced successor, if any, comes first. model: key or loose nam

tools.name: search_voices
tools.description:
Search stock voices (15,000+, so results are compact and paged: pass next_offset for more).
    model: a model id of that provider (voices compatible with it). has_sample=true returns only voices with
    an audio preview URL. use_case / age / accent (e.g. "British", "Indian") filter on values norma

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description:
Providers in the catalog with model and voice counts, headquarters, access model and compliance. Retired
    providers (shut down or no longer sold) are included only when include_retired=true, with their retirement
    date. compliance: providers must list ALL of them (e.g. ["hipaa"]); a provider t

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description:
Latest catalog changes, newest first: price changes, shutdown announcements, deprecations, models added.
    kind: one of price_changed, price_published, shutdown_announced, model_deprecated, model_removed, now_ga,
    model_added, provider_added, provider_retired.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_model, search_voices, list_providers · Private data: search_models, get_model · Public sink: list_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_model, search_voices, list_providers · Private data: search_models, get_model · Public sink: list_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_models" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
